author: Huam
body:
• Your username: Gimq
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Ban Evasion, I will explain later on.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I should not really say I have to get unbanned, I just want my ban to be reduced for an amount of time, first off, because I did one mistake that I am sure I will not do in the future, it was playing a walls game on my brothers account meanwhile I was banned, I didn't know thats illegal what I did know is that using alts to access the server meanwhile your main account is banned, I was banned for behavior in chat (Zeusy Redcued it to 5 days) And, all I am asking for is one more chance, this is after all my favorite server and community and to see me being Perm Banned really makes me sad, so please just give me one more chance and I will never do such a thing like this.
  • -Gimq/Nick Ban Appeal -2k15
